r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile?
r5-reconciliation.finding: No structural/architectural change. The anchor flip is a config-level activation of a feature already productionized in #420. Architecture docs do not need updating for a config default flip. TRIAGE CANDIDATE (out-of-scope): TypeError in sampled_runtime._run_stage (lines 446-449) where feature_schema_version is forwarded into RaceStartRecentHistoryConfig which has no such field. This is pre-existing (same TypeError pattern appears in both v1 and v2 encoding arms, and in production gold cycle 260603 where sampled_backtest results are absent from details JSON). Root cause is sampled_runtime.py forwarding manifest feature_schema_version into the adapter config — a src/ fix needed, out of scope for G1.
